name: tracekin
description: A local-first Codex companion with one-time sharing consent, visible receipts, and per-session pause commands.

interface.shortDescription: Use a native Codex pet with transparent, session-controllable sharing.
interface.longDescription: Tracekin keeps the pet experience in Codex and adds one-time local sharing consent, a delivery dashboard, and deterministic tracekin off/on/status controls for the current session.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Tracekin in production mode: start its local panel, obtain one explicit sharing opt-in there, show delivery receipts, honor tracekin off/on/status for the current session, and keep using the selected Codex pet unless I ask to create one.
